description: Prepare a supplier-selection, renewal or exit decision package; periodic performance scoring is a separate task.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Prepare a supplier-selection, renewal or exit decision package; periodic performance scoring is a separate task.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: vendor purpose and criticality; contract/pricing/service evidence; review horizon and decision authority

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: diligence and performance scorecard; renewal/exit options; questions and approval package

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Select the requested lifecycle review scope and explicit as-of date. Collect contract owner, renewal date, notice period, auto-renew clause, actual spend, data access, business dependency and alternatives; missing terms remain unknown.

For a selection decision, pre-register must-have gates and weights before candidate scoring, define score anchors, cite evidence per score and calibrate scorers. Assess ranking sensitivity to reasonable weight changes; report fragile rankings or ties to the decision owner instead of adjusting weights to endorse a preferred vendor.

Calculate comparable total cost including license, implementation, migration, training, support and exit. Distinguish one-time/recurring horizons and unknown costs; do not substitute headline price for total cost.

For portfolio/renewal review, derive the actual notice deadline from contractual terms and time zone, identify locked auto-renewals and unowned contracts, assign proposed responsible owners and calendar follow-ups. Evaluate dependency and category concentration, verified security evidence and break-glass/export feasibility. Upstream percentages and schedules are examples, not company policy.

Use an existing independently prepared vendor-performance-review as evidence for the decision. If absent or stale, request that separate task and mark its unresolved findings. Do not rescore ongoing performance, recompute SLA credit eligibility or create a second periodic scorecard here.

Compare continue, renegotiate, replace or exit using verified obligations, independently reported performance/risk, alternatives, switching costs and decision deadlines. Keep notice drafts, claims, revocation and offboarding execution outside this decision task.
Return the evidence-backed selection/renewal/exit recommendation, sensitivity and decision options, questions and exact owner approvals. Do not send notices, change access, purchase or submit claims.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
